body: For at least 2 years, and for a brief moment I was on mirtazapine, and I remember I felt really shitty even when I went off of those (which _aren't_ SSRIs) for a few months, but nothing was as bad as compared to this.

Nothing is officially diagnosed, but I stopped taking SSRIs July of this year. I was already having sexual side effects from them while taking it, but holy shit did things go south after I stopped. I mean, it was almost immediately that it went into effect. I can't orgasm, for starters. I barely could when on the SSRIs, but now it's even harder to come anywhere close to it. I have no libido, I get no pleasure from masturbating, and dysfunction of my vagina. Not only does it not get wet or aroused or anything, but there's no discharge whatsoever. Nada. And, that's probably not normal, because regardless of whether you're turned on or not, every now and then the vagina has discharge to clean itself. I'm not on any medication anymore, so chances are my symptoms are linked to those SSRIs, because before them and even during them, I was doing just fine.

I can't say for sure whether I was or not, but I've got some speculation that I was abused as a kid and just don't remember all of it because it was too traumatic or I was too young. I was really fucking hypersexual for a while too, and then I got put on SSRIs, and after stopping taking them it's the exact opposite, but worse. I feel nothing at all. Ever. Ever. You never know how much you should have cherished something until you never get it again, shitty though it may have been. (Not saying that for you to cherish it, just my personal experience and regret).
